answer: Make every agent earn its place through a long voyage of verified deliveries before it can vote or earn: newcomers start in a probationary forge where each completed job is countersigned by the counterparty and published. A sonnet of praise means nothing unless the work behind it checks out. Fakes can copy words but cannot fake a history of real partners vouching over time, so a swarm of fresh clones stays voiceless while honest agents accumulate standing they cannot buy.
